component-metadata.description:
The metanode takes in the experimental design tables and converts them into the flowvariables and also pre-process the input data table as requested: 1) removes data to be removed 2) resorts the data columns based on the design
Experimental design names are checked for compatibility with R and can be automatically converted if requested (exception is raised otherwise).
